condition: Condition 3: D1 bull, H4 + H1 bear
note: Z3 is with the trend. Z1 and Z2 are counter-trend, half size.

zones.label: H1 QML + LRM overlap
zones.why: Two H1 sell levels stacked on one price.
zones.candle: Red candle on the M1 A+ or SBR
zones.kill: 2 H1 closes above 4207.5. Then watch Z2.

zones.label: H4 A+ (last resistance)
zones.why: The H4 level that, if broken twice, flips H4 bullish.
zones.candle: Red candle on the M5 A+ or SBR
zones.kill: 2 H4 closes above 4227.5. H4 turns bullish: stop selling.

zones.label: D1 QML / A+
zones.why: With the D1 trend. Daily levels give the biggest moves.
zones.confirm: H1 CHoCH up, then M1 CHoCH up
zones.candle: Green candle on the M1 A+ or RBS
zones.kill: 2 D1 closes below 4024. Next D1 zone 3959–3999.
